items.title: Admit the reproduced explicit-negative context while preserving unsafe triage rejection
items.context: Add a focused prompt-envelope regression for the exact B-bcae-shaped safe input across every active modular reviewer role, retain representative positive and ambiguous rejection controls, then implement the smallest classifier change that makes only the safe case pass.
items.userSees: A Story containing the reproduced explicit-negative context can start every required REVIEW lane, while unsafe lifecycle triage context is still rejected.
excludes: Weakening affirmative or ambiguous triage-authority rejection

happy.desc: The focused prompt-envelope smoke assembles full REVIEW envelopes for every active modular reviewer role when given the reproduced B-bcae-shaped explicit-negative context.

edge.desc: The same smoke retains representative affirmative and ambiguous joined-clause directives and verifies that each remains rejected before an envelope digest is minted.

adversarial.desc: A mutation that removes the bounded explicit-negative allowance makes the reproduced safe fixture fail while unsafe controls stay rejected, proving the GREEN result depends on the intended narrowing.
